businessGoal: Allow visitors to view detailed information about a product

scenarios.goal: Verify that the product information (image, name, description, price, category badge, brand badge) is displayed on the product detail page
Verify that the related products section is displayed below the main product information on the product detail page
Verify that each related product is clickable and navigates to its respective detail page

manual.reason: The story describes visible browser behavior on the product detail page.

api.reason: The story does not mention any API capabilities for validating product details.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria describe the visible elements on the product detail page.
